triggers.note: Tested against every item of releases newer than sinceVersion. A hit flags at once.
Flags after 3 consecutive days with at least 20 spawns each where the value is above 50.

Per 100 spawns from a lead at the listed effort: spawns that repeat an earlier description or base name of the same session within 6 hours (a heuristic). To compare against the window before a scheduled switch instead, give the decision a rolloutId and add "baseline": { "mode": "pre-window", "ratio": true, "minPerDay": 20 } with a ratio threshold such as 1.5 and "post": { "minDays": 3 }.

Percent of reviewer verdicts FIX or BLOCK on writers a lead at the listed effort spawned. Needs a review_verdict field on reviewer spawn rows; without it the day is skipped. To compare against the window before a scheduled switch instead, give the decision a rolloutId and add "baseline": { "mode": "pre-window", "ratio": true, "minPerDay": 20 } with a ratio threshold such as 1.5 and "post": { "minDays": 3 }.

Routing-guard denials (fit, warrant, premium-cap, inherit) per 100 spawns from a lead at the listed effort. To compare against the window before a scheduled switch instead, give the decision a rolloutId and add "baseline": { "mode": "pre-window", "ratio": true, "minPerDay": 20 } with a ratio threshold such as 1.5 and "post": { "minDays": 3 }.

Percent of declared lead spawns scored "under" by the fit table. To compare against the window before a scheduled switch instead, give the decision a rolloutId and add "baseline": { "mode": "pre-window", "ratio": true, "minPerDay": 20 } with a ratio threshold such as 1.5 and "post": { "minDays": 3 }.

Main-thread plan units per spawn on a checkup day. The history keeps no effort per session, so this cannot be split by lead effort; staged against the switch instant it is the cost half of the comparison. To compare against the window before a scheduled switch instead, give the decision a rolloutId and add "baseline": { "mode": "pre-window", "ratio": true, "minPerDay": 20 } with a ratio threshold such as 1.5 and "post": { "minDays": 3 }.
